{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a central repository for all fresh ideas generated within the team. It helps in tracking, evaluating, and prioritizing ideas for future development.

## Idea Entry Format
- **Idea ID**: Unique identifier
- **Title**: Short descriptive title
- **Description**: Detailed explanation
- **Originator**: Name of the person who proposed the idea
- **Date Proposed**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Status**: Proposed / Reviewed / Approved / Rejected / Implemented
- **Priority**: Low / Medium / High
- **Notes**: Additional comments or observations

## How to Add a New Idea
1. Open this document.
2. Add a new entry following the format above.
3. Save the document.

---
